text: 令你沮丧的是，独木舟已被砍成碎片，无法修复。你和学生们查看这片破坏现场。唯一的线索是残骸周围地面上那些像小手一样的足迹。
足迹是新的。肇事者一定就在附近。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 163
text: To your dismay, your canoe has been chopped to pieces. It is beyond repair. You and your students study the vandalism. The only clues are tiny, hand-like tracks on the ground around the wreckage.
They are fresh. The perpetrators cannot be far.
